component.name: OpenSE4
component.summary: Open-source engine for Space Empires IV Deluxe

description.p: OpenSE4 is a new engine for the turn-based space strategy game Space Empires IV Deluxe. It plays the classic game faithfully, with Vulkan or OpenGL rendering, on current Linux and Windows systems.
OpenSE4 needs your own installed copy of Space Empires IV Deluxe and reads its data, art and sound in place. Nothing from the original game is included.

ul.li: The classic rules: economy, research, ship design, movement, combat, intelligence, diplomacy and the computer players
Strategic and tactical combat, combat replays and the combat simulator
Simultaneous and turn-based games, played alone, hotseat, over the network or by e-mail
A dedicated server for network and play-by-e-mail games

description.p: OpenSE4 is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the publishers of Space Empires IV Deluxe.
Computer players brought closer to the original's: fleets, scrapping, budget and base building follow rules measured on the original game.

Same results and pictures on every platform, tutorials that guide each action, Analyze and Fire On, computer control, games that start without ships as the original does, and windows laid out as the original's.
Battles shown as they are fought, round-by-round ground combat, colony cloaking, the missing colony and cargo orders, the original's fonts and pointers, and the 800x600 layout.
Every remaining rule and interface question settled from the original and implemented, and new tutorials, training games and an in-game manual.
A Windows installer, and the game's entry and icon on Linux desktops.
OpenSE4 plays only the classic game, and the remaining rule questions are settled and implemented.
